outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics cluster map (micrograph-type tissue image), not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B shows H&E micrographs with manual region annotations, not a plot of averaged data.

Panel C shows H&E micrographs and spatial gene-expression heatmaps overlaid on tissue sections. Heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since each spot already represents a single measured value, not an average requiring replicate overlay.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data points overlaid.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values derived from differential gene expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers), each bar representing a single computed statistic per gene rather than a mean of multiple individual replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.
